$description: Tier 3 — component tokens. Resolve to semantic tokens only.

bg.$description: BETA badge background — ad-hoc accent (#ffd323), NOT a brand or status colour. Correctly-named entry point for the beta-badge colour.

accessibilityBar.$description: AccessibilityBar (UX4G/GIGW top utility bar). Component-scoped dimensions and inverse state layers that mirror the Figma master 1:1. They live in Tier 3 because they are the bar's own geometry — a 46px bar height and a 33px flag chip are not shared scale steps, and the inverse overlays only make sense on this bar's brand fill.

flagWidth.$description: Flag/emblem chip width (Figma layout/flag/width); height is {size.22}, a 3:2 chip.

dividerColor.$description: Divider ink on the brand fill (Figma border/neutral/inverse-subtle, #ffffff66 = 40%). Pre-composited so consumers never hand-roll an opacity.

hoverBg.$description: Hover state layer for the bar's controls on the brand fill.

stepSize.$description: A- / A+ step button hit area.
